Sips: 0/20

BOOZE RAFT

You’re stranded on a raft in an ocean of pure alcohol. Stand at the edge, look down at the sea and sip it. Twenty sips and you’re going down. Don’t fall off.

WASD move · Shift run · Space jump · Mouse look · Click / E sip
(if the mouse won’t lock, drag to look and use E to sip)
Phone: left stick moves (push to the edge to run), drag the right side to look, JUMP and SIP buttons.
